And finally, Crown Princess Melia's accession[XENO:n ]
will take place one year from today.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Until such time, as decreed by the crown princess,[XENO:n ]
I shall assume imperial duties as regent.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

If there is anyone who objects to said decision,[XENO:n ]
state your grievances now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT15 ][XENO:del del=this ]

All the ministries are unanimous.[XENO:n ]
We have no objection to Her Majesty's decree.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]To each and every one of you, our thanks.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

If I may, Your Highness. I would like to propose a round-table[XENO:n ]
discussion on strategy concerning the Mechon.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Ah, what to do about the Mechon.[XENO:n ]
Our defences must be shored up immediately.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Not only our defences, Your Highness.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Do you suggest an offensive approach?[XENO:n ]
While the capital still licks its wounds?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The Ministry of Research has the ideal solution.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
